title: Parsing with BeautifulSoup 🍲
ques:
Write a script using `BeautifulSoup` to parse `html_doc = "

Title

"` and extract the text inside the `

` tag.

answer.content:
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup html_doc = "

Title

" soup = BeautifulSoup(html_doc, 'html.parser') print(soup.h1.text)

explanation: `BeautifulSoup` creates a parse tree, allowing you to navigate HTML elements easily via attributes like `.h1` and `.text`.
